info.description:
Farm-to-consumer traceability for GI-tagged produce (pilot: Virudhunagar Samba Vathal
dry chilli, GI 883). Every error uses the envelope `{"error": {"code", "message", "details"}}`; codes are
listed in docs/api/error-codes.md. Conventions (pagination, units, clocks, idempotency) are in
docs/api/conventions.md.
info.title: AgriTrace API

get.description: The batch's most recent grade computation with its per-parameter breakdown (FR48–FR51).

404.description: `not_found`: batch not visible or never graded.

post.description: Records any inline readings, then computes the grade from the batch's readings against the crop's profile (FR48) and compares it with the declared grade (FR49). Status `incomplete` (a required reading is missing) or `declared_above_computed` blocks the admin's approval (B09). A declared grade the profile does not know is rejected with `unknown_grade_for_profile`.

404.description: `not_found`: batch, or a reading id not on this batch.

422.description: `unknown_grade_for_profile`, `no_published_profile`, `validation_error`, or any reading error of `POST /quality-readings` for an inline reading.

get.description:
Check Postgres, Redis and object storage independently and concurrently.

Args:
    response: the outgoing response, whose status is set to 503 when any check fails.

Returns:
    One status string per dependency.

Side effects:
    Opens one DB connection, one Redis connection and one S3 request.

503.description: At least one dependency is failing.

head.description:
Answer HEAD /v1/healthz without touching any dependency.

This is the phones' reachability probe (plan §13 A1, 3 s timeout before every sync run). It must not
depend on S3 or the DB: a slow S3 would make every phone think it is offline and stop pushing
entries, and a deep check per probe would multiply backend load on a public route.

Returns:
    An empty 200 response.

200.description: The API is reachable; dependencies are not checked.
